تستحثون (form X)
# تَسْتَحِثُّونَ (tastaḥiṯṯūna) /tas.ta.ħiθ.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# تُسْتَحَثُّونَ (tustaḥaṯṯūna) /tus.ta.ħaθ.θuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
